chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad informed me, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ʿAmīrah, from Abī Bakr, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام, “What should I do when I become junub?” He said, “Wash your hands and your private part, perform wudu (ablution) as for salat (prayer), then perform ghusl (ritual bath).”

key_terms.أَجْنَبْتُ: I entered the state of janabah requiring ritual purification

ai.seo_question: What should a person do when becoming junub according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding ghusl after janabah. It teaches the sequence of washing the hands and private part, then performing wudu (ablution) for salat (prayer), and then completing ghusl.
